# Zerro

> **Talk to your screen. Zerro does the work.** A lightweight macOS menu bar app. Record your screen, explain what you want, and get it done faster. Zerro turns a screen recording and spoken instructions into exactly what you need: an agent prompt, a ready-to-send message, a code or spreadsheet snippet, a written-up document, or a clear answer to your question. Frame a region of your screen, dictate what you want, and Zerro puts ready-to-use text on your clipboard. Paste it into Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude, or any tool that takes text, or send it to a person. Processing (including best-effort secret redaction) always happens on your Mac first to prepare the recording; on Zerro Cloud the prepped recording and your narration go to a third-party AI provider (OpenAI, Google, or Anthropic), or, with BYOK, straight to that provider on your own key, no Zerro servers in the middle and no account required.

Zerro is built for anyone who would rather talk through what they want than type it out: handing a coding agent real context, drafting a message about what's on screen, grabbing the exact formula or snippet, turning messy notes into a clean write-up, or getting a confusing screen explained. You speak roughly 4× faster than you type; Zerro closes that gap by capturing what's on screen alongside what you say.

## How it works

- Hit the hotkey and drag to frame the part of your screen Zerro should see.
- Dictate what you want in plain language, up to 3 minutes per recording.
- Zerro prepares the recording locally on your Mac, then makes a single API call.
- Ready-to-use text lands on your clipboard: the artifact that fits what you asked for (an agent prompt, a message, a snippet, a document) or a plain-language answer.

## Key facts

- Platform: native macOS app (Swift & SwiftUI, built on ScreenCaptureKit). Not Electron.
- Processing: local-first, meaning your recording is prepared on your machine.
- Keys: bring your own OpenAI, Gemini & Anthropic keys, stored in the macOS Keychain.
- Recording cap: 3 minutes per recording, for fast and predictable cost.
- Distribution: signed & notarized .dmg, with Sparkle auto-updates.
- Free trial: start with 30 Zerro Cloud Trial credits or 10 successful BYOK generations. No card or time limit.
- Pricing: BYOK is $69 one-time (includes 1 year of updates). Zerro Cloud is $15/month, or $12/month billed yearly ($144/year), with 300 credits per month. Both available now.
